explanation: Shylock is the moneylender. Antonio, the merchant, borrows from him on behalf of his friend Bassanio and pledges a pound of his own flesh as security.

claims.text: In The Merchant of Venice, the merchant of the title is Antonio.
Shylock is a moneylender, Bassanio is Antonio's friend and Lorenzo is a friend of Bassanio who elopes with Jessica, so none of them is the merchant of the title.
Antonio borrows money from Shylock on behalf of his friend Bassanio.
Antonio agrees to forfeit a pound of his own flesh if the loan is not repaid.
